speed_model._method: Predict speed distribution from TOTAL ROUTE DISTANCE via linear regression (distance-share basis), then apply +/-5% Hare/Tortoise correction. Do NOT hard-code a fixed split — it scales with route distance.
speed_model.correction_rule: FAST (Hare): +5% to 14kn share, -5% to 8kn share, 11kn unchanged. SLOW (Tortoise): inverse (-5% 14kn, +5% 8kn). Editable constant.
speed_model.time_conversion: shares are of DISTANCE; convert to time per speed, remainder of 168h total at anchor (0 kn). Energy = sum(time_at_speed * (electrical_kw + hotel_kw)).

diesel_reserve._usage: Realistic backstop (option 1). Depletes only after 50 MWh battery is spent. Near-impossible to exhaust in a week (~7x battery). The scoring TEETH remain the -1 point/MWh diesel penalty on the base; the reserve is physical honesty + the gauge drama when diesels wake.
